# utilities.consolidation.run_consolidation

### utilities.consolidation.run_consolidation(core_cfg: [Mapping](https://docs.python.org/3/library/typing.html#typing.Mapping)[[str](https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#str), [Any](https://docs.python.org/3/library/typing.html#typing.Any)] | [None](https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/constants.html#None) = None, \*, gadm_gpkg: [str](https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#str) | [None](https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/constants.html#None) = None, country_codes: [Iterable](https://docs.python.org/3/library/typing.html#typing.Iterable)[[str](https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#str)] | [None](https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/constants.html#None) = None, dry_run: [bool](https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/functions.html#bool) = False, registry: [Any](https://docs.python.org/3/library/typing.html#typing.Any) | [None](https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/constants.html#None) = None, run_id: [str](https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#str) | [None](https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/constants.html#None) = None, close: [bool](https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/functions.html#bool) = True, name_locations: [bool](https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/functions.html#bool) = True, include_grid_names: [bool](https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/functions.html#bool) = False, overwrite_human_names: [bool](https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/functions.html#bool) = False, audit_country_geometry: [bool](https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/functions.html#bool) = False) → [Dict](https://docs.python.org/3/library/typing.html#typing.Dict)[[str](https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#str), [Any](https://docs.python.org/3/library/typing.html#typing.Any)]
